concerns.text: The plan cites `https://huggingface.co/datasets/tner/btc/resolve/main/dataset/label.json` as a source of daily OHLCV data for Bitcoin. This dataset is a JSON label file for a text‑classification task and does not contain the required `date`, `open`, `high`, `low`, `close`, `volume` columns, making it inappropriate for the research question.

The plan cites `https://huggingface.co/datasets/disco-eth/EuroSpeech/resolve/main/bosnia-herzegovina/test-00000-of-00002.parquet` as a source of daily OHLCV data for Ethereum. This is a speech‑audio dataset (EuroSpeech) and contains no financial OHLCV fields, so it cannot satisfy FR‑001.

Bootstrap likelihood‑ratio tests with 10 000 resamples (and 5 000 for HMM) are scheduled to run on the free‑tier GitHub Actions runner using only 2 CPU cores. Empirical profiling suggests that a full 10 000‑sample bootstrap for a VAR model on ~3 600 rows can exceed the 6‑hour CI time budget, risking a timeout. The plan should either reduce the number of resamples or implement a more efficient approximation to stay within the compute constraints.
